name: StoryBites
tagline: Personalised, dyslexia-friendly audiobooks built from a child's interests and reading level.
problem: Accessible reading tools for children with dyslexia are rare and expensive; a friend had to move abroad for help.
solution: Parents enter interests and level; the app generates bite-sized stories with natural narration and an in-story dictionary.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter a child's interests and play a story made for them.

why_it_stood_out.claim: A beginner team building for a friend's experience.

lessons: Beginner prizes reward a clear user and a finished flow.
